response.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM pa) AS idx FROM pa), h AS (SELECT idx.*, AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - hand_avg AS diff_from_hand_avg FROM h ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC LIMIT 10
